description: Krao communities: a community is a net.krao.community.profile record in its owner's repo; members, moderators and posts are records in the repos of the accounts involved, indexed by Krao's indexer.

access.description: Who may join. 'open': anyone; 'approval': the owner or a moderator approves each member; 'condition': the member's linked wallets meet the conditions (checked again from time to time); 'verified': the member verified a phone number or passed KYC with Krao.

conditions.description: For 'condition': the same conditions as token gates.

match.description: Whether all conditions must be met or any one of them. Defaults to 'all'.

slug.description: The record key of the profile record.

avatar.description: CID of the avatar blob in the owner's repo.

memberCount.description: Members in good standing, including the owner and moderators.

feed.description: The community's feed generator (rkey community-<slug> in the owner's repo, served by the indexer), when the owner published one. It lists the community's public posts.

viewerState.description: The viewer's place in the community. 'member': in good standing; 'pending': joined, waiting for approval (or for the first check of the conditions); 'ineligible': joined, but does not meet the conditions or is not verified; 'banned'; 'none': has not joined.

eligible.description: For 'condition' and 'verified' communities: whether the viewer meets the requirement now (also when they have not joined).

reason.description: Why the viewer is not a member, eg 'NotVerified', 'ConditionsNotMet', 'AwaitingApproval', 'Banned'.

membership.description: The viewer's net.krao.community.membership record, if any.

submission.description: The net.krao.community.submission record that put the post in the community.
